items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Sponsored Agents and AI tools for ChatGPT ads
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is introducing AI-powered ad experiences, including a test of Sponsored Agents that let users start a labeled conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking a ChatGPT ad. It also rolled out prompt-based campaign creation in ChatGPT Work, AI creative assistance inside Ads Manager, and new HubSpot and Shopify integrations so advertisers can create and track campaigns in tools they already use.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布推出AI廣告體驗，測試Sponsored Agents：使用者點擊ChatGPT廣告後可與標示為商家贊助的代理人開始對話。同時在ChatGPT Work以提示詞建立活動、在Ads Manager加入AI創意協助，並與HubSpot、Shopify整合，讓廣告主在既有工具中建立與追蹤活動。
items_flat.analysis_en: This productizes ChatGPT as a discovery and conversion surface, not a new model. Whether Sponsored Agents stay clearly separated from independent answers will determine whether the ads principles hold in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把ChatGPT做成發現與轉換介面，不是新模型。Sponsored Agents能否與獨立回答清楚區隔，將決定其廣告原則能否在實務上成立。
items_flat.quote: We’re testing Sponsored Agents, which let people start a conversation with a business-sponsored agent after clicking an ad in ChatGPT.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在測試Sponsored Agents，讓人們在ChatGPT點擊廣告後，與商家贊助的代理人開始對話。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic merges Claude Chat and Cowork into one assistant
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Claude對話與Cowork合併為單一助手
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude so users no longer pick a mode: the assistant decides whether a request is a quick answer or a longer task, including work that continues after the laptop is closed. It also launched Claude Docs and Claude Slides in beta and said Claude Design now works inside conversations. The change is rolling out first to Pro and Max on web, desktop and mobile; Team and Free follow, and Enterprise admins get at least 30 days’ notice.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布Claude Cowork與對話合併為單一Claude，使用者不必選模式：助手自行判斷是快速回答或較長任務，即使筆電闔上也可繼續。同步推出測試版Claude Docs與Claude Slides，Claude Design也可在對話中使用。先向Pro與Max的網頁、桌面與行動版推出，Team與Free隨後，Enterprise管理員至少提前30天收到通知。
items_flat.analysis_en: Folding agentic Cowork into every conversation is a product bet that routing should be the model’s job. Enterprise lag and how well Claude chooses task versus chat will decide whether this reduces friction or hides costly agent runs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把代理人式Cowork收進每則對話，等於押注路由該由模型決定。企業版延遲上線、以及Claude區分任務與閒聊的準確度，將決定這是降低摩擦還是把昂貴代理人執行藏起來。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude. Bring a quick question, or hand over a report due at noon, and Claude takes it from there, even after you’ve closed your laptop.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude Cowork與對話合併為單一Claude。無論是快速提問，或交出中午要交的報告，Claude都會接手，即使你已闔上筆電。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Novo partner to use Claude in drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic與Novo合作，以Claude投入藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Novo and Anthropic announced on 16 September 2026 that Novo will use Anthropic models and Claude Science on R&D scientific reasoning and agentic software engineering. The companies said they will jointly tackle identified discovery problems and build tools for biological reasoning; Novo CEO Mike Doustdar said the firm aims to become “the world’s most AI-driven healthcare company.” Financial terms were not disclosed.
items_flat.summary_zh: Novo與Anthropic於2026年9月16日宣布，Novo將使用Anthropic模型與Claude Science進行研發科學推理與代理人式軟體工程。雙方將共同處理已鎖定的發現問題並打造生物推理工具；Novo執行長Mike Doustdar稱公司目標是成為「全球最以AI驅動的醫療公司」。財務條款未揭露。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves Claude from Novo’s earlier documentation use case into discovery science itself. Impact still depends on which workflows Claude Science is allowed to touch and how tightly results are validated in the lab.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓Claude從Novo先前的文件場景進入發現科學本身。影響仍取決於Claude Science被允許接觸哪些工作流程，以及實驗室驗證有多嚴。
items_flat.quote: AI’s increasing capability brings with it the potential to compress a century’s worth of biological and medical breakthroughs into a decade.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI能力提升，有可能把一個世紀的生物與醫學突破壓縮成十年。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI confirms talks with Anthropic and Google on an AI safety standards body
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI證實與Anthropic、Google討論AI安全標準機構
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it has been discussing industry-led AI safety coordination with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, following Demis Hassabis’s earlier idea of a FINRA-like standards body. OpenAI global policy chief Chris Lehane told reporters the talks have run for weeks and that OpenAI supports a FRONTIER Act provision on independent verification organizations inside frontier labs. No charter or shared evaluator was announced.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示已與Anthropic、Google DeepMind討論產業主導的AI安全協調，呼應Hassabis稍早提出類似FINRA的標準機構構想。OpenAI全球政策主管Chris Lehane向記者表示討論已進行數週，並支持FRONTIER法案中在前沿實驗室嵌入獨立驗證組織的條文。尚未宣布章程或共享評估方。
items_flat.analysis_en: A joint evaluator or pre-release test regime would be material if it gets binding access and publish rights. So far this is confirmed talk, not a charter, and antitrust plus smaller-lab exclusion remain live constraints.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若聯合評估方或發布前測試制度具備具約束力的存取與公開權，才會真正改變格局。目前只是證實在談、沒有章程，反壟斷與排除較小實驗室仍是現實約束。
items_flat.quote: It’s better to try to work together to prioritize safety.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最好試著合作，把安全放在優先位置。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches the DeepMind Institute for AGI debate
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched the DeepMind Institute as a platform for essays and debate on AGI’s technical and societal questions, directed by Shane Legg, James Manyika and Demis Hassabis, with Legg as managing editor. The site opened with pieces on reasoning transparency, economic policy for AGI, utopianism and frontier testing; authors say the views are not Google’s official position. Axios reported the institute launched Wednesday.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出DeepMind Institute，作為討論AGI技術與社會問題的文章與辯論平台，由Shane Legg、James Manyika與Demis Hassabis擔任董事，Legg兼任主編。網站首批文章涵蓋推理透明度、AGI經濟政策、烏托邦主義與前沿測試；作者聲明不代表Google官方立場。Axios報導該機構於週三啟動。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a publishing and convening vehicle, not a model or safety evaluator. Its value turns on whether outside authors can disagree in public and whether the essays feed product or policy decisions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是出版與召集機制，不是模型或安全評估機構。價值取決於外部作者能否公開異議，以及文章是否進入產品或政策決策。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching the DeepMind Institute (DMI) to spur the interdisciplinary research, collaboration and debate required to answer the AGI era's most critical technical and societal questions.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們成立DeepMind Institute（DMI），以推動回答AGI時代最關鍵技術與社會問題所需的跨領域研究、合作與辯論。

items_flat.title_en: Google opens Home MCP so third-party agents can control Nest devices
items_flat.title_zh: Google開通Home MCP，讓第三方代理人控制Nest裝置
items_flat.summary_en: Google began early access to a Google Home MCP server so MCP-capable agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes, OpenClaw and Google Antigravity can inspect structures, read event history and control devices in the Home ecosystem, including Nest and Matter devices. Access is rolling out to U.S. Google Home Premium Advanced subscribers; setup requires a Google Cloud project and OAuth. Gemini for Home remains the default on the Home app and Nest speakers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google開始提供Google Home MCP伺服器早期存取，讓支援MCP的代理人（如Claude、ChatGPT、Hermes、OpenClaw與Google Antigravity）檢視住家結構、讀取事件紀錄並控制Home生態系裝置，含Nest與Matter。將向美國Google Home Premium Advanced訂戶逐步開放；設定需Google Cloud專案與OAuth。Home App與Nest喇叭預設仍是Gemini for Home。
items_flat.analysis_en: Opening locks, cameras and HVAC to arbitrary agents is a real capability jump and a concentrated security surface. The $20 Premium Advanced gate and Cloud-project setup will keep this niche until auth scopes and audit logs are simpler.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 把門鎖、攝影機與空調交給任意代理人是能力躍進，也是集中的安全面。月費20美元的Premium Advanced門檻與Cloud專案設定，在授權範圍與稽核日誌簡化前會讓這功能維持小眾。
items_flat.quote: This allows any AI agents that support MCP, including Google Antigravity, Claude, Hermes or Open Claw, to securely work with all of the devices and event history in your Google Home ecosystem.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這讓任何支援MCP的AI代理人，包括Google Antigravity、Claude、Hermes或OpenClaw，能安全地使用Google Home生態系中的裝置與事件紀錄。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic signs agreement for first Australian data centre in Queensland
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic簽署協議，將在昆士蘭設立首座澳洲資料中心
items_flat.summary_en: Queensland Premier David Crisafulli said Anthropic signed an agreement for its first Australian data centre at the planned Western Downs Digital Park near Dalby, part of a Zerra DC project reported at about A$32 billion. ABC News said the lease is subject to Foreign Investment Review Board approval and that the site is intended to open next year; local reporting said the capacity is aimed at inference for Claude.
items_flat.summary_zh: 昆士蘭州長David Crisafulli表示，Anthropic已簽署協議，將在Dalby附近規劃中的Western Downs Digital Park設立其首座澳洲資料中心，屬Zerra DC約320億澳元計畫的一部分。澳洲廣播公司指出租約須經外國投資審查委員會核准，預計明年啟用；地方報導稱產能將用於Claude推論。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a capacity and sovereignty story more than a model story. The FIRB condition and local energy rules remain the binding uncertainties before any Claude traffic actually lands in Queensland.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產能與主權故事，不是模型故事。FIRB條件與當地能源規範，仍是Claude流量真正落到昆士蘭前的關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: To have secured Anthropic’s first major investment in Australia is a massive show of confidence in Queensland.
items_flat.quote_zh: 爭取到Anthropic在澳洲的首筆重大投資，是對昆士蘭極大的信心展現。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One paid plans bundling apps and extra AI usage
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Meta One付費方案，捆綁App與額外AI用量
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Meta One, a subscription spanning Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and Meta AI, with individual Plus plans plus Core and Premium-style bundles that add more usage of compute-heavy AI features. Meta said more than 50 features are live, more than 15 million subscriptions and trials have accumulated during phased rollout, and core app functions plus basic Meta AI stay free. Plans start at $2.99 a month for a single product.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta推出橫跨Instagram、Facebook、WhatsApp與Meta AI的訂閱Meta One，含單一產品Plus方案及可提高高算力AI用量的組合方案。Meta表示已上線逾50項功能，分階段導入累計超過1,500萬訂閱與試用，核心App與基本Meta AI仍免費。單一產品方案每月起價2.99美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is monetization of assistant and creator features rather than a new frontier model. Conversion will depend on whether paid AI quota and Business Agent capacity are scarce enough to feel necessary.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是助手與創作者功能變現，不是新的前沿模型。轉換率取決於付費AI配額與Business Agent產能是否稀缺到讓人覺得必須付費。
items_flat.quote: The core experience across our apps and Meta AI will stay free.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們各App與Meta AI的核心體驗將維持免費。

items_flat.title_en: Meta opens WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for coding agents
items_flat.title_zh: Meta開放WhatsApp Business Tools MCP供程式代理人使用
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced a WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server that lets agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business Platform assets. The beta remote server can create accounts, verify numbers, manage templates and related assets without a separate console-first workflow.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta宣布WhatsApp Business Tools MCP伺服器，讓Claude、Cursor、Codex或ChatGPT等代理人能建立與管理WhatsApp商業平台資產。測試版遠端伺服器可建立帳號、驗證號碼、管理模板等，不必先走獨立後台流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving third-party agents admin-level WhatsApp setup reduces onboarding friction and concentrates operational risk in MCP auth scopes. Availability is still a gradual beta.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓第三方代理人擁有WhatsApp管理級開通能力，降低導入摩擦，也把營運風險集中在MCP授權範圍。目前仍是逐步測試。
items_flat.quote: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP changes that. It's an MCP server that connects your Service Provider AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) to the WhatsApp Business Platform, directly in your workflow.
items_flat.quote_zh: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP改變了這一點。它是一台MCP伺服器，讓你的AI程式代理（Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT）直接在工作流裡連接WhatsApp Business Platform。

items_flat.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral models in Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral合作，將Mistral模型接入Firefox Smart Window
items_flat.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced a partnership to power Firefox Smart Window beta with Mistral models, starting with Mistral Small 4 for users in the US and Canada and expanding Smart Window plus French-language support in France, with the UK and Germany expected later. Both firms said conversations are not saved on Mozilla servers by default and that Mistral agrees to zero data retention.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布合作，以Mistral模型驅動Firefox Smart Window測試版，先向美國與加拿大提供Mistral Small 4，並在法國擴大Smart Window與法文支援，英國與德國預計稍後跟進。雙方表示對話預設不存在Mozilla伺服器，且Mistral同意零資料留存。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a distribution win for open-weight models inside a major browser, not a new frontier checkpoint. Share of Smart Window traffic versus default Big Tech models will show whether the privacy pitch converts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是開權重模型打進主流瀏覽器的通路勝利，不是新的前沿權重。Smart Window流量相對預設大廠模型的占比，才能看出隱私訴求有沒有轉換。
items_flat.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mozilla的AI瀏覽助手Firefox Smart Window（測試版）現已由Mistral模型驅動。

items_flat.title_en: Grok Build v1.0.33 tightens MCP, memory and long-running agent sessions
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Build v1.0.33強化MCP、記憶體與長時代理人工作階段
items_flat.summary_en: Release notes circulated for Grok Build v1.0.33 describe structured JSON from MCP tools, cancelled tool calls that now notify the server to stop, in-modal memory deletion, and preservation of compaction checkpoints in long-running sessions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 流傳的Grok Build v1.0.33版本說明指出：MCP工具改回傳結構化JSON、取消的工具呼叫會通知伺服器停止、可在視窗內刪除記憶，以及長時工作階段保留壓縮檢查點。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is tooling reliability, not a Grok 4.7 model drop. It matters for people already running Grok Bot / Grok Build workflows; it does not change the public frontier-model ladder.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是工具可靠度更新，不是Grok 4.7模型發布。對已在跑Grok Bot／Grok Build工作流的人有意義，不改變公開前沿模型梯隊。

anthropic.quote: To have secured Anthropic’s first major investment in Australia is a massive show of confidence in Queensland.
anthropic.quote_zh: 爭取到Anthropic在澳洲的首筆重大投資，是對昆士蘭極大的信心展現。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind launches the DeepMind Institute for AGI debate
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched the DeepMind Institute as a platform for essays and debate on AGI’s technical and societal questions, directed by Shane Legg, James Manyika and Demis Hassabis, with Legg as managing editor. The site opened with pieces on reasoning transparency, economic policy for AGI, utopianism and frontier testing; authors say the views are not Google’s official position. Axios reported the institute launched Wednesday.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出DeepMind Institute，作為討論AGI技術與社會問題的文章與辯論平台，由Shane Legg、James Manyika與Demis Hassabis擔任董事，Legg兼任主編。網站首批文章涵蓋推理透明度、AGI經濟政策、烏托邦主義與前沿測試；作者聲明不代表Google官方立場。Axios報導該機構於週三啟動。
google.analysis_en: This is a publishing and convening vehicle, not a model or safety evaluator. Its value turns on whether outside authors can disagree in public and whether the essays feed product or policy decisions.
google.analysis_zh: 這是出版與召集機制，不是模型或安全評估機構。價值取決於外部作者能否公開異議，以及文章是否進入產品或政策決策。
google.quote: We’re launching the DeepMind Institute (DMI) to spur the interdisciplinary research, collaboration and debate required to answer the AGI era's most critical technical and societal questions.
google.quote_zh: 我們成立DeepMind Institute（DMI），以推動回答AGI時代最關鍵技術與社會問題所需的跨領域研究、合作與辯論。

google.title_en: Google opens Home MCP so third-party agents can control Nest devices
google.title_zh: Google開通Home MCP，讓第三方代理人控制Nest裝置
google.summary_en: Google began early access to a Google Home MCP server so MCP-capable agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes, OpenClaw and Google Antigravity can inspect structures, read event history and control devices in the Home ecosystem, including Nest and Matter devices. Access is rolling out to U.S. Google Home Premium Advanced subscribers; setup requires a Google Cloud project and OAuth. Gemini for Home remains the default on the Home app and Nest speakers.
google.summary_zh: Google開始提供Google Home MCP伺服器早期存取，讓支援MCP的代理人（如Claude、ChatGPT、Hermes、OpenClaw與Google Antigravity）檢視住家結構、讀取事件紀錄並控制Home生態系裝置，含Nest與Matter。將向美國Google Home Premium Advanced訂戶逐步開放；設定需Google Cloud專案與OAuth。Home App與Nest喇叭預設仍是Gemini for Home。
google.analysis_en: Opening locks, cameras and HVAC to arbitrary agents is a real capability jump and a concentrated security surface. The $20 Premium Advanced gate and Cloud-project setup will keep this niche until auth scopes and audit logs are simpler.
google.analysis_zh: 把門鎖、攝影機與空調交給任意代理人是能力躍進，也是集中的安全面。月費20美元的Premium Advanced門檻與Cloud專案設定，在授權範圍與稽核日誌簡化前會讓這功能維持小眾。
google.quote: This allows any AI agents that support MCP, including Google Antigravity, Claude, Hermes or Open Claw, to securely work with all of the devices and event history in your Google Home ecosystem.
google.quote_zh: 這讓任何支援MCP的AI代理人，包括Google Antigravity、Claude、Hermes或OpenClaw，能安全地使用Google Home生態系中的裝置與事件紀錄。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Meta One paid plans bundling apps and extra AI usage
meta.title_zh: Meta推出Meta One付費方案，捆綁App與額外AI用量
meta.summary_en: Meta introduced Meta One, a subscription spanning Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and Meta AI, with individual Plus plans plus Core and Premium-style bundles that add more usage of compute-heavy AI features. Meta said more than 50 features are live, more than 15 million subscriptions and trials have accumulated during phased rollout, and core app functions plus basic Meta AI stay free. Plans start at $2.99 a month for a single product.
meta.summary_zh: Meta推出橫跨Instagram、Facebook、WhatsApp與Meta AI的訂閱Meta One，含單一產品Plus方案及可提高高算力AI用量的組合方案。Meta表示已上線逾50項功能，分階段導入累計超過1,500萬訂閱與試用，核心App與基本Meta AI仍免費。單一產品方案每月起價2.99美元。
meta.analysis_en: This is monetization of assistant and creator features rather than a new frontier model. Conversion will depend on whether paid AI quota and Business Agent capacity are scarce enough to feel necessary.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是助手與創作者功能變現，不是新的前沿模型。轉換率取決於付費AI配額與Business Agent產能是否稀缺到讓人覺得必須付費。
meta.quote: The core experience across our apps and Meta AI will stay free.
meta.quote_zh: 我們各App與Meta AI的核心體驗將維持免費。

meta.title_en: Meta opens WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for coding agents
meta.title_zh: Meta開放WhatsApp Business Tools MCP供程式代理人使用
meta.summary_en: Meta announced a WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server that lets agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business Platform assets. The beta remote server can create accounts, verify numbers, manage templates and related assets without a separate console-first workflow.
meta.summary_zh: Meta宣布WhatsApp Business Tools MCP伺服器，讓Claude、Cursor、Codex或ChatGPT等代理人能建立與管理WhatsApp商業平台資產。測試版遠端伺服器可建立帳號、驗證號碼、管理模板等，不必先走獨立後台流程。
meta.analysis_en: Giving third-party agents admin-level WhatsApp setup reduces onboarding friction and concentrates operational risk in MCP auth scopes. Availability is still a gradual beta.
meta.analysis_zh: 讓第三方代理人擁有WhatsApp管理級開通能力，降低導入摩擦，也把營運風險集中在MCP授權範圍。目前仍是逐步測試。
meta.quote: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP changes that. It's an MCP server that connects your Service Provider AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) to the WhatsApp Business Platform, directly in your workflow.
meta.quote_zh: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP改變了這一點。它是一台MCP伺服器，讓你的AI程式代理（Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT）直接在工作流裡連接WhatsApp Business Platform。

xai.title_en: Grok Build v1.0.33 tightens MCP, memory and long-running agent sessions
xai.title_zh: Grok Build v1.0.33強化MCP、記憶體與長時代理人工作階段
xai.summary_en: Release notes circulated for Grok Build v1.0.33 describe structured JSON from MCP tools, cancelled tool calls that now notify the server to stop, in-modal memory deletion, and preservation of compaction checkpoints in long-running sessions.
xai.summary_zh: 流傳的Grok Build v1.0.33版本說明指出：MCP工具改回傳結構化JSON、取消的工具呼叫會通知伺服器停止、可在視窗內刪除記憶，以及長時工作階段保留壓縮檢查點。
xai.analysis_en: This is tooling reliability, not a Grok 4.7 model drop. It matters for people already running Grok Bot / Grok Build workflows; it does not change the public frontier-model ladder.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是工具可靠度更新，不是Grok 4.7模型發布。對已在跑Grok Bot／Grok Build工作流的人有意義，不改變公開前沿模型梯隊。

frontier_other.title_en: OpenAI confirms talks with Anthropic and Google on an AI safety standards body
frontier_other.title_zh: OpenAI證實與Anthropic、Google討論AI安全標準機構
frontier_other.summary_en: OpenAI said it has been discussing industry-led AI safety coordination with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, following Demis Hassabis’s earlier idea of a FINRA-like standards body. OpenAI global policy chief Chris Lehane told reporters the talks have run for weeks and that OpenAI supports a FRONTIER Act provision on independent verification organizations inside frontier labs. No charter or shared evaluator was announced.
frontier_other.summary_zh: OpenAI表示已與Anthropic、Google DeepMind討論產業主導的AI安全協調，呼應Hassabis稍早提出類似FINRA的標準機構構想。OpenAI全球政策主管Chris Lehane向記者表示討論已進行數週，並支持FRONTIER法案中在前沿實驗室嵌入獨立驗證組織的條文。尚未宣布章程或共享評估方。
frontier_other.analysis_en: A joint evaluator or pre-release test regime would be material if it gets binding access and publish rights. So far this is confirmed talk, not a charter, and antitrust plus smaller-lab exclusion remain live constraints.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 若聯合評估方或發布前測試制度具備具約束力的存取與公開權，才會真正改變格局。目前只是證實在談、沒有章程，反壟斷與排除較小實驗室仍是現實約束。
frontier_other.quote: It’s better to try to work together to prioritize safety.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 最好試著合作，把安全放在優先位置。

frontier_other.title_en: Mozilla and Mistral put Mistral models in Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.title_zh: Mozilla與Mistral合作，將Mistral模型接入Firefox Smart Window
frontier_other.summary_en: Mozilla and Mistral announced a partnership to power Firefox Smart Window beta with Mistral models, starting with Mistral Small 4 for users in the US and Canada and expanding Smart Window plus French-language support in France, with the UK and Germany expected later. Both firms said conversations are not saved on Mozilla servers by default and that Mistral agrees to zero data retention.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mozilla與Mistral宣布合作，以Mistral模型驅動Firefox Smart Window測試版，先向美國與加拿大提供Mistral Small 4，並在法國擴大Smart Window與法文支援，英國與德國預計稍後跟進。雙方表示對話預設不存在Mozilla伺服器，且Mistral同意零資料留存。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is a distribution win for open-weight models inside a major browser, not a new frontier checkpoint. Share of Smart Window traffic versus default Big Tech models will show whether the privacy pitch converts.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是開權重模型打進主流瀏覽器的通路勝利，不是新的前沿權重。Smart Window流量相對預設大廠模型的占比，才能看出隱私訴求有沒有轉換。
frontier_other.quote: Firefox Smart Window (beta), Mozilla’s AI browsing assistant, is now powered by Mistral models.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mozilla的AI瀏覽助手Firefox Smart Window（測試版）現已由Mistral模型驅動。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped Sponsored Agents and prompt-based ChatGPT ads. Anthropic merged Claude Chat with Cowork and partnered with Novo on Claude Science; Queensland announced its first Australian data-centre lease. Google opened Home MCP to third-party agents and launched the DeepMind Institute. Meta pushed Meta One. Mozilla put Mistral in Firefox Smart Window.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出Sponsored Agents與提示詞廣告工具。Anthropic合併Claude對話與Cowork，並與Novo合作用Claude Science做藥物研發；昆士蘭宣布其首座澳洲資料中心租約。Google開通Home MCP給第三方代理人並成立DeepMind Institute。Meta推Meta One。Mozilla把Mistral接入Firefox Smart Window。
